description: Use it to open a trade-evidence session, issue an execution receipt, or verify an evidence artifact after a trade. Each call selects the branch with "op": begin_evidence, issue_receipt or verify_evidence. Do not use it to decide whether a trade is safe before signing (use trade_guard) and do not use it to settle a swap guard (use the venue guard tools). Returns the evidence session handle, the signed receipt, or the verification verdict, digest and matched evidence. Absorbs the deprecated names begin_trade_evidence, issue_execution_receipt and verify_evidence. Metering: begin_evidence and issue_receipt are C4 (40 credits / $0.040); verify_evidence is free for the three offline kinds (execution_pair, base_agent_swap, solana_swap) and C4 for live reads.

chain_id.description: Execution chain id. Independent on-chain route quotes are currently available only on Ethereum mainnet (chain_id 1); other chains return [unavailable:unsupported_chain] without billing.

decision.description: Required for settle modes; the signed guard decision

decision_input.description: Required quote evidence: {source, destination, routeQuotePrice, routeQuoteObservedAt} (old camelCase shape)

receipt.description: Required for mode=receipt; old execution_receipt fields

name: trade_proof
